definitions.explanation: Performing tasks quickly and smoothly with good technique. Describes someone who handles work or tasks with admirable skill.

examples.japanese: {手際|てぎわ}よく⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{手際|てぎわ}よい⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦ぶり→〜ぶり：28358_buri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{感心|かんしん}した→感心する：21451_kanshinsuru⟧。
examples.english: I was impressed by how efficiently he worked.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新人|しんじん}→新人：02500_shinjin⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{手際|てぎわ}よく⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{素晴|すば}らしい→素晴らしい：01119_subarashii⟧。
examples.english: It's impressive that she can handle things so deftly even though she's new.

notes:
USAGE:
{手際|てぎわ}よい is often used in the adverbial form {手際|てぎわ}よく. The noun ⟦{手際|てぎわ}→手際：06657_tegiwa⟧ alone means "skill" or "performance." The negative form ⟦{手際|てぎわ}→手際：06657_tegiwa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧ means clumsy or inefficient.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {手際|てぎわ}よく⟦{片付|かたづ}ける→片付ける：01192_katazukeru⟧ (to tidy up efficiently)
- {手際|てぎわ}よく⟦{進|すす}める→進める：01949_susumeru⟧ (to proceed smoothly)
- ⟦{手際|てぎわ}のいい→手際のいい：16280_tegiwanoii⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (a deft person)

FORMS:
⟦{手際|てぎわ}のいい→手際のいい：16280_tegiwanoii⟧ and ⟦{手際|てぎわ}→手際：06657_tegiwa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ are also commonly used with the same meaning.
